lUhUGrnM.description: Calls an Elasticsearch or Kibana API operation and returns the raw response body. Elastic Agent Builder truncates oversized responses before the agent sees them, so the agent narrows results with parameters such as filters, size limits, or field ...
snippets: execute_esql, generate_esql, and search exclude documents in frozen tier indices. get_index_mapping can omit fields that exist only in frozen backing indices of a data stream, an alias, an index pattern, or a remote index.

Custom ES|QL tools execute their queries directly, so this tool is only needed for running arbitrary queries, such as those generated by generate_esql or provided by the user. The tool accepts an optional filter parameter containing a Query DSL query. Elasticsearch applies this filter before running the ES|QL query, so the query reads only documents that match the filter. The filter can only narrow the query input. Because Elasticsearch parses the filter separately from the ES|QL query, the filter can't reference ?named parameters. The filter parameter also affects field discovery.

Calls an Elasticsearch or Kibana API operation and returns the raw response body. Elastic Agent Builder truncates oversized responses before the agent sees them, so the agent narrows results with parameters such as filters, size limits, or field selections. Before each call to an operation that can change or delete existing data, execute_api requests confirmation unless the agent's Auto-approved APIs setting includes the operation.
